contract:
## Shared Types

- `SectionData`: `{ id: string, title: string, content: string, svgId: string, audioCue: string }` — Represents a scrollable content block with associated SVG and audio.
- `PlutoModelConfig`: `{ radius: number, rotationSpeed: number, layers: string[], metadata: Record<string, string> }` — Configuration for the interactive 3D/SVG model of Pluto.
- `AudioAsset`: `{ id: string, src: string, type: 'sfx' | 'ambient' }` — Metadata for sound effects and background audio.
- `AnimationState`: `{ id: string, trigger: 'scroll' | 'click' | 'idle', duration: number, keyframes: string[] }` — Definition for SVG/CSS animations triggered by user interaction or scroll position.

## API Contract (Module Interfaces)

- `audioManager` (`js/audio.js`): `{ play(id: string, volume?: number): void, pauseAll(id?: string): void, setMasterVolume(v: number): void, initAudio(): void }`
- `contentLoader` (`js/content.js`): `{ loadSections(): Promise<SectionData[]>, loadPlutoData(): PlutoModelConfig }`
- `animationEngine` (`js/animations.js`): `{ registerAnimation(config: AnimationState): void, trigger(id: string): void, cleanup(): void }`
- `plutoModel` (`js/pluto-model.js`): `{ render(container: HTMLElement, config: PlutoModelConfig): void, handleInteraction(event: Event): void }`
- `sectionsRenderer` (`js/sections.js`): `{ renderSections(sections: SectionData[], container: HTMLElement): void, setupScrollObserver(): void }`
- `app` (`js/app.js`): `{ init(): Promise<void> }` — Orchestrates module initialization and DOM readiness.

## Naming Conventions

- Modules: camelCase (`pluto-model.js`, `audio.js`)
- Functions/Methods: camelCase (`loadPlutoData`, `handleInteraction`, `setupScrollObserver`)
- CSS Classes: kebab-case with `pluto-` prefix (`pluto-section`, `pluto-model-layer`, `pluto-nav`)
- IDs/Classes: semantic, descriptive, no generic placeholders like `div1` or `box`
- Assets: kebab-case (`pluto-atmosphere.svg`, `pluto-data.json`)
- Variables/Constants: UPPER_SNAKE_CASE for configuration constants, camelCase for runtime values.

/**
 * @typedef {Object} SectionData
 * @property {string} id
 * @property {string} title
 * @property {string} content
 * @property {string} svgId
 * @property {string} audioCue
 */

/**
 * @typedef {Object} PlutoModelConfig
 * @property {number} radius
 * @property {number} rotationSpeed
 * @property {string[]} layers
 * @property {Record<string, string>} metadata
 */

/**
 * @typedef {Object} AudioAsset
 * @property {string} id
 * @property {string} src
 * @property {'sfx' | 'ambient'} type
 */

/**
 * @typedef {Object} AnimationState
 * @property {string} id
 * @property {'scroll' | 'click' | 'idle'} trigger
 * @property {number} duration
 * @property {string[]} keyframes
 */

export {};

Model Explore

subtasks.task: User can navigate the main page with a dynamic space background, responsive layout, and global audio controls.
acceptance_criteria: index.html loads without errors and links to css/main.css and js/app.js
css/main.css defines CSS variables for theme, layout, and responsive breakpoints
js/audio.js exports play/pause/setMasterVolume/initAudio with correct signatures
js/types.js exports SectionData, AudioAsset, AnimationState type definitions
js/app.js initializes core modules, handles DOMContentLoaded, and sets up viewport resize listener

subtasks.task: User can explore Pluto's basic data via an interactive SVG model with hover/click effects and related sound cues.
acceptance_criteria: js/content.js exports loadPlutoData() returning PlutoModelConfig and loadSections() returning Promise<SectionData[]>
js/pluto-model.js exports render() and handleInteraction() with correct signatures
assets/pluto-data.json contains valid Pluto metadata matching PlutoModelConfig shape
SVG model renders inside #pluto-model-container and responds to mouse events
Clicking/hovering model parts triggers audio cues via audioManager.play()

subtasks.task: User can scroll through detailed sections with scroll-triggered SVG animations and contextual audio.
acceptance_criteria: js/animations.js exports registerAnimation() and trigger() with correct signatures
js/sections.js exports renderSections() and setupScrollObserver() with correct signatures
Scrolling triggers keyframe animations on SVG elements via animationEngine
Contextual audio plays on section entry via audioManager
Animations respect prefers-reduced-motion media query defined in css/main.css
